settings.general.chimes_detail: Quiet cues for input, completion, and memory pauses.
settings.general.confirm_close_detail: Ask before closing a session with a running process.
settings.general.copy_diagnostics_detail: Preview a privacy-safe report before copying it.
settings.general.include_hint: One pattern per line, saved to ~/.diri-include. Hidden folders stay skipped unless they match. Wildcards follow gitignore rules, including nested folders.
settings.general.interface_language_deta: Menus, settings and labels. Agent output and terminal text stay as they are.
settings.general.lineage_detail: Mark them while the pointer or keyboard cursor rests on a session.
settings.general.perf_overlay_detail: Frame rate, frame times, dropped frames and memory over the window.
settings.general.render_counters_detail: Badge the main views with how often they render, and list them in the overlay.
settings.general.roots_empty_hint: Empty uses your home folder plus project parent folders. Add root opens the system picker.
settings.general.roots_hint: One folder per line, scanned four levels deep. Add root adds another.
settings.general.title: General
settings.updates.automatic_detail: Download verified GitHub releases and install when diri quits.
settings.updates.skip_version_detail: Hide this release until a newer version is available.
settings.updates.title: Software updates
